__instructions: Copy this template to add or complete a major/minor without touching app code.
1. Fill in the fields below from the program's official requirements page.
2. Set status to ACTIVE (placeholders use NEEDS_DATA_ENTRY).
3. Paste the object into the programs list in tools/build_data.py (or replace a placeholder with the same id), run `python3 tools/build_data.py`, then `npm run build`.
n_of              {type, n, options: [codes]}                       - choose n from the list
sequence_one_of   {type, sequences: [[codes], [codes]]}             - complete every course of ONE sequence
n_from_filter     {type, n, filter:{depts, minNumber, maxNumber, minCredits?, wOnly?, exclude?}}
track_n_of        {type, n, tracks: {trackName: [codes]}}           - n courses all from one track
breadth_outside_track {type, n, trackGroupId}                       - n courses from tracks other than the chosen one
Course codes must match the catalog form: 'DEPT NNN' or 'DEPT NNNW' (e.g. 'CSC 172', 'PSCI 202W').
If a referenced course is missing from src/data/courses.json, add it there too (or it will be treated as unplaceable).

Schema extensions (added for the Biology batch): apIbCreditExcluded (AP/IB-bucket courses never fill this program's groups), minPctFromHomeInstitution (warns when transfer credit exceeds the allowed share of non-ancillary requirements; mark exempt groups with "ancillary": true), minMajorGPA (checked against student-entered grades; ancillary groups are excluded). Groups may also set "allowReuse": true (course may satisfy this group AND others in the same program) and rules may use "optionsRef" for shared option lists.
name: Program Name
notes: GPA / progression / transfer rules stated on the official page, quoted or paraphrased.
